en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town at the edge of a hilly landscape with terraced vineyards. In the foreground are orchards and gardens bordered by low wooden fences, and a straight tree‑lined street with a few pedestrians and an early motor vehicle. Along the street stand large, ornate bourgeois villas with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the distant left on a hilltop is a prominent church or monastery complex; further right on another hill is a small tower. Terraces and vineyard strips cover the hillsides. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
